items.title: Apache Patches Critical HTTP Server RCE Found by Anthropic, Google
items.originalTitle: Apache Patches Critical HTTP Server RCE Found by Anthropic, Google
items.summary: The mod_http2 race condition, CVE-2026-119618, could let unauthenticated attackers execute code on servers with HTTP/2 enabled. The post Apache Patches Critical HTTP Server RCE Found by Anthropic, Google appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.why: Falhas exploráveis exigem atualização rápida; vale revisar se o sistema afetado existe no seu ambiente.
